title: Support Lifecycle Map

stages.question: Is the report redacted, minimal, and safe to discuss publicly?
Is this a docs example, fixture backlog item, or rule-review candidate?
Which public-safe reply should go back to the reporter?
Was the immediate support decision recorded with a safe next link?
Is the follow-up low-priority docs, medium-priority fixture work, or high-priority rule review?
Is there a sanitized backlog artifact with evidence and checks?
Does the item remain active, or should it close as closed-no-action?

privacyGuardrail: Route secrets, private code, private paths, customer data, full logs, unredacted SARIF, package publishing credentials, MCP data exposure, or exploitable security details through SECURITY.md instead of the public lifecycle.
